left.name: Even exponent evaluates minus-one power to one
left.description: If a scalar exponent is even, then minus one raised to that exponent equals one.

right.name: Even scalar implies congruence to zero modulo two
right.description: An even integer scalar symbol is congruent to zero modulo two.

left.name: Odd exponent evaluates minus-one power to minus one
left.description: If a scalar exponent is odd, then minus one raised to that exponent equals minus one.

right.name: Odd scalar implies congruence to one modulo two
right.description: An odd integer scalar symbol is congruent to one modulo two.
